name: Feature sections
description: Three page sections for a list of product features: a bento of small live tiles, a grid divided by hairlines, and a list that answers the pointer.

props.name: title
props.description: The section headline, set in the display face. It sits in the top-left of the layout.

props.name: description
props.description: A supporting paragraph under the headline.

props.name: action
props.description: A button or link under the paragraph.

props.name: tiles
props.type: { title: string; description: string; visual: ReactNode; surface?: "card" | "well" | "picture" }[]
props.description: Four tiles, placed as one tall tile on the right, one under the headline and two across the bottom. A picture tile lets its visual fill the whole tile and sets the text over it.

props.name: alerts
props.description: The alerts to cycle through. Three are shown, newest on top; a new one ticks in on each interval while the list is on screen.

props.name: interval
props.description: Seconds between new alerts.

props.name: ages
props.description: The time shown beside each row, by position.

props.name: src
props.description: The image that fills the tile.

props.name: alt
props.description: Alternative text for the image.

props.name: place
props.description: Where the reading in the chip was taken.

props.name: temperature
props.description: The reading. The chip drifts a few tenths around it so the tile looks live.

props.name: unit
props.description: Unit after the reading.

props.name: map
props.description: An image of contour lines on a transparent background. It is used as a mask and tinted with the text colour at low contrast.

props.name: stations
props.type: { name: string; x: number; y: number }[]
props.description: Stations in percent of the tile, joined by a dashed route. A pulse travels along them in order.

props.name: color
props.description: Colour of the dots, pulses and route.

props.name: values
props.description: The series. The line draws itself the first time it comes into view.

props.name: value
props.description: The current reading, shown large above the line.

props.name: label
props.description: What the reading is.

props.name: change
props.description: A short change note beside the reading.

props.name: from
props.description: Label under the start of the line.

props.name: to
props.description: Label under the end of the line.

props.name: color
props.description: Colour of the line and its fill.

props.name: title
props.description: The section headline.

props.name: description
props.description: A paragraph set to the right of the headline on wide screens.

props.name: features
props.type: { title: string; description: string; href?: string }[]
props.description: Eight features fill four columns and two rows. A feature with href is a link.

props.name: texture
props.description: An image of contour lines on a transparent background. Each cell shows a different corner of it at low contrast, a little stronger on hover.

props.name: textureColor
props.description: The colour the texture is tinted with.

props.name: title
props.description: The section headline, centred.

props.name: description
props.description: A centred paragraph under the headline.

props.name: features
props.type: { title: string; description: string; icon?: ReactNode; href?: string }[]
props.description: The features. On hover or keyboard focus a water bar fills the cell's left rule, a pale wash rises and the title moves 4px right. With href each cell is a link.
